title: Harrow: Duration Extender vs Compress Cooldown on Wretched Vapors
question: Does +22% Vapors duration beat -18% Vapors cooldown, given Healing Needles T3 already stretches ally buffs up to 200%?
hypothesis: Compress gives 22% more rushes; Duration Extender adds 1.1s to a 5s rush that needles can already double, and banks more crash damage. Prediction: ally damage taken per 120s is >=10% lower with Compress; crash damage landed is lower with Compress.
controls: Cooldowns, HP, leech stacks reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the item/imbue under test
Same enemy hero, level, items, behaviour
procedure: 120s fight; Vapors on the ally on cooldown
Needle the ally during each rush (extends it)
Record rush seconds, crash damage landed, ally HP lost

decision.rule: SUPPORTS compress_cooldown if >=10% lower with non-overlapping ranges
